== Description ==
The '''Clanker''' was a lead [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared in the fourth night of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. It had a decent amount of health and walked at a below average speed. It was also a lead enemy, so many towers were unable to damage it.

== Appearance ==
The '''Clanker''' was a mechanical humanoid out of grey and yellow metal. Its appearance was a mix of steampunk and normal machinery. It had multiple clockworks on its body. It had a cross on its face similar to classic [[Normal]]. It also walked with a cartoonish style.

== Strategy ==
*The [[Mortar]], Level 2+ [[Pursuit]] and [[Ace Pilot]] can be very effective against this.
**Towers, such as the [[Accelerator]] are also recommended, though it is rather expensive to afford early on.
**The [[Pyromancer]] can also be used to damage the '''Clanker'''.
***Do note that the [[Pyromancer]] can speed up the '''Clanker''' and other enemies by 15%.
*The [[Toxic Gunner]] is a great counter to the '''Clanker''' as both its regular and poison damage can damage it. 
**Additionally, it can also slow down the '''Clanker'''.

== Trivia ==
*The name of the '''Clanker''' may be a reference to ''Star Wars'', as the [[w:c:starwars:Clone Trooper|Clone Troopers]] often call the [[w:c:starwars:Droid|Droids]] a ''Clanker''.
*This, alongside the [[Mega Clanker]], are the first lead enemies that do not appear in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode.
*'''Clankers''' were considered to be added in [[The Great Finale]] during the [[Lunar Overture Event]] due to the [[Golden Soldier]] being able to handle every enemy present in the map, though this never happened.
*The face used by the '''Clanker''' is inspired by the face [[w:c:madnesscombat:Grunt|Grunt]]s have in the Newgrounds series ''Madness Combat''.
